00100008.name: _start
00100008.why: Sony crt0 entry; identical to FF2 crt0.s _start (libmatch); Ghidra had called it entry

00100248.name: _exit
00100248.why: crt0 thunk j Exit (FF2 symbol _exit at the same address); the FF3 reference called the thunk Exit

002045a8.name: main
002045a8.why: crt0 _start calls it (jal at 0x100238) after _InitSys and atexit; prints the version with the build date Jul 27 2006 22:25:45, detects the boot device (host0 / cdrom0) and reboots the IOP with ioprp300.img

00266770.name: sceSifLoadElfPart

00266790.name: sceSifLoadElf

002675b8.name: kCopy_initsys

00267600.name: kFindAddress
